$description: Wiener Werkstätte — Vienna Workshop, founded 1903. Josef Hoffmann and Koloman Moser's Gesamtkunstwerk vocabulary: geometric rigor, Klimt gilding, and Biedermeier warmth.

syncupsuite.foundation.story: Josef Hoffmann and Koloman Moser's Vienna Workshop unified fine art and craft under geometric rigor. Their black-and-white checkerboard motifs, Klimt-gilded surfaces, and Biedermeier cream walls created a distinctly Viennese vocabulary that lives between ornament and abstraction.
syncupsuite.foundation.philosophy: Gesamtkunstwerk — the total work of art, where every object from building to teaspoon belongs to the same aesthetic whole

seedColors.name: Gold (Klimt-Gold)
seedColors.tradition: Klimt gilding — gold leaf on Secession paintings. The warmth and material opulence of Vienna's artistic golden age.
seedColors.source: Gustav Klimt: Painting, Design and Modern Life, T. Natter & G. Frodl

seedColors.name: Crimson (Werkstätte Rot)
seedColors.tradition: Werkstätte textile dyes — lacquered tin boxes and woven fabric. The warm red of Viennese craft tradition.
seedColors.source: Wiener Werkstätte: Design in Vienna 1903–1932, C. Brandstätter

seedColors.name: Charcoal (Schmiedeeisen)
seedColors.tradition: Secession building wrought iron — Josef Hoffmann's geometric ironwork. The black of structural craft.

seedColors.name: Cream (Wiener Weiß)
seedColors.tradition: Viennese plasterwork walls — Biedermeier domestic interiors. The warm white ground of all Werkstätte composition.
seedColors.source: Vienna 1900: Art, Life & Culture, C. Schorske
